rounds.text: Thakral Services (India) Ltd is displaying clear signs of an operational turnaround that are currently being overlooked by stagnant historical price trends. Compounded profit growth has accelerated impressively, achieving 15% over 5 years, 26% over 3 years, and surging by 132% in the trailing twelve months [E14, E15, E16]. This earnings momentum is backed by a dramatic acceleration in top-line performance, with compounded sales growth reaching 83% over the trailing twelve months and quarterly sales expanding by 69% year-over-year [E12, E41]. Furthermore, quarterly operating margins have staged a remarkable recovery, jumping 88 percentage points in September 2026 compared to the severe losses of the year-ago quarter [E22]. Fundamentals are visibly outpacing the stock price, as historical profit growth significantly outpaces 5-year share price growth and recent earnings expansion outstrips 1-year price performance [E35, E36]. Conceded: [E9], [E10], [E11], [E21], [E32], [E33].

Thakral Services (India) Ltd carries severe valuation risks and structural deterioration that the current price fails to reflect. The stock trades at an exorbitant P/E of 272x [E1], towering over the sector benchmark of 21.26x [E6], alongside an extreme EV/EBITDA of 407.88x compared to a sector median of 12.25x [E8]. This lofty pricing is completely detached from reality when evaluated against a discounted cash flow intrinsic value of Rs 2 per share, resulting in a staggering margin of safety of -715.0% [E32, E33]. Furthermore, historical performance reveals a chronic collapse in top-line demand, evidenced by compounded sales growth of -66% over 3 years, -46% over 5 years, and -27% over 10 years [E9, E10, E11]. Operational execution remains highly problematic, marked by a negative operating margin of -39% in the TTM period [E21], negative operating and free cash flows of Rs -0.10 Cr in March 2026 [E26, E27], and bloated debtor days stretching to 153 days [E39]. Conceded: compounded profit growth stands at 132% in the trailing twelve months and quarterly operating margins improved by 88 percentage points year-over-year [E16, E22]. However, the reverse DCF indicates that today's price already demands an unrealistic 45.7% earnings growth [E34], leaving the equity vulnerable to severe downside if sentiment corrects.

Conceded: [E1, E6, E8, E32, E33, E34]. The bear's fixation on multiples and DCF outputs ignores the powerful fundamental turnaround currently underway, where trailing twelve-month profit growth of 132% and 5-year profit growth of 15% show earnings are outpacing 5-year price growth of 3%, signalling a classic fundamentals-led divergence [E14, E16, E35]. While historical multi-year sales contracted [E9, E10, E11], the business has experienced a violent inflection with TTM sales growth leaping to 83% and quarterly sales surging 69% YoY, invalidating backward-looking growth narratives [E12, E41]. Operational execution is actively correcting, proven by a dramatic 88 percentage point year-over-year expansion in quarterly operating margin as of September 2026 [E22]. Furthermore, stable, high promoter conviction at 74.00% anchors the equity against transient sentiment corrections [E30], while results scoring 84/100 confirm that improving fundamentals far outweigh stale, backward-looking valuation metrics [E48].

Conceded: [E14, E16, E22, E30, E41]. Conceding that profitability and quarterly sales have inflected does not rescue the business from a staggering valuation mismatch where a reverse DCF demands an unsustainable 45.7% future earnings growth rate against a base case of just 15.0% [E34]. The bull's reliance on recent profit spikes glosses over a severe structural deterioration, highlighted by a negative operating margin of -39% in the TTM and a long-term sales contraction with a 10-year compounded sales growth rate of -27% [E9, E21]. Furthermore, high debtors of 153 days severely compromise the quality of any reported earnings growth [E39], while negative operating and free cash flows of -0.10 Cr in March 2026 prove that cash generation is entirely absent [E26, E27]. When layered against an astronomical P/E of 272x and an EV/EBITDA of 407.88x that dwarf sector benchmarks, these operational headwinds mean the current market price of ₹ 13.9 is already pricing in perfection, leaving a catastrophic margin of safety of -715.0% [E1, E2, E6, E8, E33].
